name: DEAR Inventory
description_en:
DEAR is the former name of Cin7 Core: Cin7’s official January 2023 announcement explicitly connects the two names. Current research therefore uses Cin7 Core’s inventory, order, sales and manufacturing material while preserving this catalog record’s historical identity.

Core connects product operations with commerce and accounting applications. It should be evaluated separately from Cin7 Omni, whose customization and commercial scope are different.
description_zh:
DEAR 是 Cin7 Core 的旧名称，Cin7 于 2023 年 1 月的官方公告明确说明两者关系。因此本次使用当前 Cin7 Core 的库存、订单、销售和制造资料，同时保留目录记录的历史身份。

Core 将商品运营与电商及会计应用连接。评估时应与 Cin7 Omni 区分，后者的定制和商务范围不同。

sections.title_en: Connect a channel sale to fulfillment and accounting
sections.title_zh: 连接渠道销售、履约与会计
sections.en: Map SKUs and opening balances, connect one sales channel, then run a purchase receipt and a sale through fulfillment and the chosen accounting connection. Include a return to check quantity and value reconciliation. Shopify, Amazon, Xero and QuickBooks are named integrations, but connector existence alone does not establish support for every regional edition or transaction type.
sections.zh: 映射 SKU 与期初余额，连接一个销售渠道，再测试采购收货、销售履约及所选会计连接。加入一次退货，检查数量与价值核对。官网列出 Shopify、Amazon、Xero 和 QuickBooks，但存在连接器不等于支持所有地区版本与交易类型。

sections.title_en: Keep the DEAR history and Core/Omni distinction
sections.title_zh: 保留 DEAR 历史并区分 Core 与 Omni
sections.en: The official announcement effective January 9, 2023 says DEAR becomes Cin7 Core and the older Cin7 product becomes Cin7 Omni. It separately names Orderhive. This is evidence for the DEAR/Core relationship, not permission to merge every Cin7-branded product. The redirected current domain is retained as genuine source evidence.
sections.zh: 2023 年 1 月 9 日生效的官方公告说明 DEAR 更名 Cin7 Core，旧 Cin7 产品更名 Cin7 Omni，并单独提到 Orderhive。这支持 DEAR/Core 的关系，不能据此合并所有 Cin7 品牌产品；当前跳转域名保留为真实来源证据。

sections.title_en: Size users, integrations and annual order volume
sections.title_zh: 核算用户、集成与年度订单量
sections.en: Current new-customer prices are USD $349/$599/$1,199 per month before tax for Standard/Pro/Advanced. They include 5/10/15 users, 2/4/6 commerce/app integrations and 6,000/24,000/120,000 sales orders per year. Unlimited inventory locations do not mean every warehouse has advanced WMS: the comparison distinguishes single-location standard WMS from advanced multi-location functions. Extra capacity and add-ons require separate confirmation.
sections.zh: 当前新客户 Standard/Pro/Advanced 税前月价为美元 $349/$599/$1,199，含 5/10/15 用户、2/4/6 电商或应用集成，以及每年 6,000/24,000/120,000 销售订单。库存地点不限不等于各仓都含进阶 WMS：对照表区分单地点标准 WMS 与多地点进阶功能。额外容量及附加模块需另行确认。

sections.title_zh: 迁移前确认必要附加模块
sections.en: Growing product businesses needing connected commerce, stock and light assembly are plausible candidates. Forecasting, B2B portals, POS, APIs and advanced manufacturing have plan-specific or add-on treatment; do not price them from the entry fee alone. Test batch/serial rules and canceled-order reconciliation using actual representative data. No production integration or migration was performed.
sections.zh: 需要连接电商、库存及轻量组装的成长型商品企业可评估。预测、B2B 门户、POS、API 和进阶制造存在版本或附加收费差异，不能只按入门价估算。应以代表性数据测试批次、序列号与取消订单核对。未运行生产集成或迁移。
